name: Hui Min
headline: Claims processor at an insurer
story: Her company just announced an AI triage pilot. She has about three months before her role is redesigned, and six hours a week to learn. She does not need fifty job ideas. She needs to know which parts of her job to bet on, and what to learn first.

name: Arif
headline: Executive assistant at a government-linked company
story: His director now drafts her own emails with an AI assistant. Arif's calendar work is shrinking and he wants to move toward operations before his role is merged.

name: Mei Ling
headline: Customer service agent at a telco contact centre
story: A voice bot now takes the first minute of every call. Mei Ling handles what it cannot, and wonders whether that is a job or a countdown.

name: Kavitha
headline: Bookkeeping clerk at a manufacturing SME
story: Her firm is moving to cloud accounting that reads invoices on its own. She has 18 years of experience and three spare hours a week.

name: Daniel
headline: Document translator (English, Bahasa Malaysia, Chinese)
story: Clients now send machine-translated drafts and ask him to fix them for half the fee. He has evenings free and wants a direction, not a panic.
